title: Atori SMP Staffel 2 Mini Edition
description: Modpack for the second season of the Atori SMP. Lightweight Edition!
body:
# Atori SMP Season 2 Modpack (Mini Edition)
This is a modpack for the players of Atori SMP to join the server. This does not include the server-side mods of the SMP.

This is the light-weight edition of the modpack. Striving for better FPS and compatibility on lower hardware.

There are also two other version of this modpack, geared towards higher-end systems for better immersion.
